visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A top-down close-up shot displays two round metal tins, one blue and one yellow, filled with star-shaped cookies in original and chocolate flavors. A hand is seen adjusting a cookie. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene shifts to a handheld walking shot through a brightly lit indoor shopping mall. Stacks of yellow and blue cookie tins are arranged on a counter at a pop-up stall labeled 'Cookie 886'. (3) A staff member wearing a grey polo shirt, yellow collar, and a black face mask is seen handing a wooden tasting tray with chocolate cookies to a customer. The background shows blurred shoppers and mall fixtures. (4) A close-up shows a hand pulling a black branded 'Cookie 886' shopping bag toward the camera. (5) In a tight close-up, a hand removes a protective white parchment paper from a blue tin, revealing fresh cookies. (6) Several extreme close-up shots follow, showing a hand picking up, breaking, and holding individual star-shaped cookies (original, cocoa, and tea flavors), emphasizing their crumbly texture. (7) The camera captures a close-up of a hand opening a yellow gift box containing individually wrapped cookies and butterfly-shaped palmiers. (8) A hand breaks a heart-shaped butterfly pastry (Palmier) and then a round chocolate-flecked cookie to show the internal layers. (9) A hand holds up a large black shopping bag in front of the retail stall. (10) The video ends with a static shot of a blue and yellow information board detailing store location, pop-up dates (5/22-6/12), and product prices.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional vlog for the 'Cookie 886' pop-up store at Kaohsiung Dream Mall. It utilizes high-tempo editing and appetizing close-ups to showcase the cookie's texture and ingredients, enticing viewers to visit the event before it closes in mid-June.
